method.rule: 9:15-9:45 range breakout; first 1-minute close outside it by 13:00 buys the ATM call (up) or put (down) at the next minute; SL when NIFTY crosses back to the other side of the range; otherwise exit at 15:15. 1 lot, nearest expiry. Stop-loss: the bought option's own 9:15-9:45 low (live from 26 Nov 2026; earlier real days used NIFTY crossing back through the range).
method.prices: Times and levels: real NIFTY 1-minute prices. Option prices: a model set each day from NSE's real option prices; 'real' days are the app's own paper trades on real option prices.
method.bias: The model flatters option buyers by about Rs 160-330 a trade (checked on real prices).
